title: Land grab pushes viewers back from Area 51
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Land grab pushes viewers back from Area 51, about 1990s at Nevada test site and Area 51, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: UFO researcher Grant Cameron, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that in the 1990s President Bill Clinton took back land around Area 51, a secret US Air Force test site in the Nevada desert. As Cameron tells it, this pushed back the people who used to watch the base from nearby, which hints that there was something there worth hiding.
